Messages.Author: Zenedar
Messages.Body:
Hello! I'm just wondering if I can "stutter-step strike" with a bundi for the extra damage. Thanks!

Bundi
[Equipment] Equipment

[2 Pool]

Melee weapon.
Strike: hand strike at +1 damage. (This strike is both a hand strike and a melee weapon strike). Bearer may prevent 1 damage from each melee weapon strike made against him or her.

Stutter-Step
[Combat] Combat

[Celerity] Celerity

[cel] Strike: dodge.
[CEL] Strike: hand strike and dodge. Only usable if both strike: hand strike and strike: dodges could be chosen (individually). Only usable at close range. Not usable as an additional strike, and this vampire cannot use any additional strikes this round

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Going off the card texts alone.

Yes.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Zenedar wrote:
> Hello! I'm just wondering if I can "stutter-step strike" with a bundi for the extra damage. Thanks!
>
You can't, because you can't use two source of strikes at the same time.

Stutter-step is a strike by itself (that combines the effect of two kind of strike: a hand strike and a dodge.)
The "hand strike" is really a hand-strike, not a "use a melee weapon as a strike".

Bundi grants a strike that is a hand strike and a melee weapon strike, but it's another source of strike.

See also  groups.google.com/forum/?hl=fr#!msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/JtLgB7Apqq0/lWdtq38KJ-wJ

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
